journeys.flow: ArtifactEditorでMermaid図を含むdesign.mdを開き、プレビューモードに切り替える
journeys.expectedResult: Mermaid図がSVGとしてレンダリングされる
journeys.reason: Covered by existing test suite 'UJ-001: Mermaid SVG rendering in ArtifactEditor' with tests: display ArtifactEditor with design tab, render Mermaid diagrams as SVG in preview mode, render multiple Mermaid diagrams (Req 4.2), not affect non-Mermaid code blocks (Req 2.3)
testDescriptions: should display ArtifactEditor with design tab
should render Mermaid diagrams as SVG in preview mode
should not affect non-Mermaid code blocks (Req 2.3)

journeys.flow: 編集モードでMermaidコードを変更し、プレビューモードで確認する
journeys.expectedResult: 変更がリアルタイムで反映される
journeys.reason: Covered by existing test suite 'UJ-002: Real-time preview update' with test: should update preview when Mermaid code is changed
testDescriptions: should update preview when Mermaid code is changed

journeys.flow: 不正なMermaid構文を入力し、プレビューを確認する
journeys.expectedResult: エラーメッセージと生コードが表示される
journeys.reason: Covered by existing test suite 'UJ-003: Error handling for invalid Mermaid syntax' with test: should display error message for invalid Mermaid syntax. Verifies both error message (Req 2.1) and raw code display (Req 2.2)
testDescriptions: should display error message for invalid Mermaid syntax

journeys.flow: 複数のMermaidブロックを含むドキュメントをプレビューする
journeys.expectedResult: すべての図が正しくレンダリングされる
journeys.reason: E2E not required per Verification Contract. Functionality is indirectly covered by UJ-001 test 'should render multiple Mermaid diagrams (Req 4.2)' which verifies multiple diagram rendering

journeys.flow: Remote UI版ArtifactEditorでMermaid図をプレビューする
journeys.expectedResult: Electron版と同様にレンダリングされる
journeys.reason: Covered by existing test suite 'UJ-005: Remote UI Mermaid preview' with tests: connect to Remote UI, display Spec list, select spec and display ArtifactEditor, render Mermaid diagrams in Remote UI preview
testDescriptions: should display Spec list in Remote UI
should select spec and display ArtifactEditor
should render Mermaid diagrams in Remote UI preview

testSuites: UJ-001: Mermaid SVG rendering in ArtifactEditor
UJ-003: Error handling for invalid Mermaid syntax
